summary: SOLAI Limited (formerly BIT Mining) filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at an EGM of a share consolidation and authorised capital increase. The company will consolidate every 700 shares of $0.00005 par value into one share of $0.035 par value, increasing authorised share capital from $1.94M to $3.5B. Fractional Class A and preference shares will be rounded up, while fractional Class B shares will be rounded down, cancelling all issued Class B shares. This capital restructuring reduces share count, potentially increasing per-share value and simplifying the capital structure, though no explicit return of capital is stated.
